story.hook: "It Takes Two" is a song by New York City hip-hop duo Rob Base & DJ E-Z Rock that became a top-40 single and was later certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA).

story.fullStory:
Rob Base's "It Takes Two" reached #36 on the Billboard Hot 100. "It Takes Two" is a song by New York City hip-hop duo Rob Base & DJ E-Z Rock that became a top-40 single and was later certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA).

Since its release in 1988 by Profile Records, the song has been covered and sampled by several recording artists.

"There are many critics and listeners who claim that Rob Base & DJ EZ Rock's 'It Takes Two' is the greatest hip-hop single ever cut," noted music critic Stephen Thomas Erlewine of AllMusic.

The song peaked at #36 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.
